cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Approve the Harmless Version
cards.instruction: Get approval for a harmless version of your plan, then gradually reveal what that approval now commits them to.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. May I put one extra chair in the hall?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Excellent. It's for the chair of my new tenants' committee.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I approved furniture, not a committee.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then welcome to our first agenda item: what your chair authorises.

mechanism: A obtains permission for a chair, then coaches its former meeting pupil into treating that furniture consent as approval to host and minute a new committee.
confusable: Not asking openly for meeting permission: A reveals growing obligations only after small furniture approval.
comparison: Hall furniture to committee secretary versus two guests to wider-family hosting.
